sections.title: Context and brief
paragraphs: Senda Norte is a craft vermouth at 8 % vol. that keeps the ritual of the aperitif without the heaviness of high-strength vermouth. It sits between classic vermouth and light Atlantic wines.

sections.title: Brand
paragraphs: The naming evokes origin and path. A reinterpreted classical serif, deep green, warm cream and soft red, and a close, calm tone of voice.

sections.title: Development
list: Hybrid Rhine bottle: 303 mm tall, Ø 80 mm base, Ø 68 mm grip, Ø 30 mm mouth, 75 cl
